name: Passphrase Generator
summary: Generate memorable diceware-style passphrases from a 1,024-word dictionary — entirely in your browser.
description: Build strong, readable passphrases with 3–12 words, custom separators, optional capitalization, and optional digit/symbol suffixes. Entropy is estimated from dictionary size. Uses your browser’s CSPRNG. Educational client-side tool — not a password manager.

faqs.question: How strong is a six-word passphrase?
faqs.answer: With a 1,024-word list, each word contributes about 10 bits. Six words are roughly 60 bits before optional digit/symbol extras.

faqs.question: Is this the EFF diceware list?
faqs.answer: No. Forge uses a fixed 1,024-word client dictionary sized for the browser bundle. Increase word count if you need more entropy.

faqs.question: Are passphrases uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
